policy: Each catalog model has its own source photograph; reuse is limited to variants/platforms within that same catalog model.

records.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a clean square source photograph for actual prompt-based segmentation by MobileSAM, later composited into an existing light-gray model-result website banner. Photograph one red mountain bicycle standing upright beside a simple pale concrete wall on an uncluttered paved courtyard. Both complete wheels, frame, handlebars, saddle and pedals must be fully visible, accurate bicycle geometry and spokes. Bicycle centered in the middle of the square, occupying around 78 percent of image width and 55 percent of height, with generous clear margin. Soft natural daylight, realistic materials, editorial product photography, restrained colors. No people, animals or additional bicycles. This is ONLY the original input photo: no segmentation mask, points, boxes, outlines, interface, graphs, labels, words, logos or watermarks.
records.role: Unique input photograph; model outputs are computed separately.
